spans.s: śiṭā, app. rope: tatra (sc. on coming to three mountain-peaks, parvataśṛṅgāṇi) tvayā vetra-śiṭāṃ baddhvātikramitavyam Divy 〔113.16〕, there you must gird yourself with staff (or does vetra, q.v., also mean rope, or the material used for one ?) and rope (for mountain-climbing) and pass over (them); 〔274.23〕, see s.v. viṣṭhā; te hi śiṭā-karkaṭakaprayogenābhiroḍhum ārabdhāḥ 〔281.2〕 (of thieves entering a house to steal jewels).
